name: cortico-world-mouse-polling-fix
description: 性能优化：Coopanion 桌宠鼠标回报率修复。用 Cortico World 关闭逐事件鼠标转发，并把页面 pointermove 合并到每帧，解决 500Hz 以上、尤其 8000Hz 拖动卡顿。安装后重启 Coopanion，启用「鼠标回报率修复」后再重启一次，否则不生效。A Cortico World for Coopanion. 作者 funst，QQ 2674459204。

cortico.displayName: 鼠标回报率修复（Mouse Polling Fix）

zh.description: 性能优化：解决 Coopanion 桌宠在高鼠标回报率下的卡顿。关闭全局逐事件鼠标转发，并把桌宠页面的 pointermove 合并到每帧。安装后重启，启用后再重启一次，否则不生效。作者 funst，QQ 2674459204，MIT 协议。

en.description: Fixes Coopanion's high-polling-rate mouse lag by removing per-event mouse forwarding and coalescing the pet page's pointermove to one per frame. Restart after install, then restart again after enabling. Author: funst (QQ 2674459204), MIT.

scripts.test: node test/patch.test.mjs && node test/world.test.mjs && node test/auto.test.mjs
